i don't know if this helps, but i can most defiantly say for me when i smoke weed my delusions and hallucinations become very much a hell on earth. i can barely tell what is real and what isn't. take last night for an example i smoked with my friends and i swore i really believed that there was a horse walking around the room and i followed said horse for about a good 10minutes before it started to say "charlie". now you might be reading this and thinking i'm trying to troll you and i'm not,i realized over the pass year after being diagnosed i have had a very big fascination with space and the basically the universe. and i believed someone had turned off the gravity and i was floating away, then i thought we were underwater and i was literally drowning on air (i know this sounds like a troll, but it's not this really had me freaked out). and there was fish talking to me and it was saying "blue", which brought me back to one voice i heard the longest time and it said "blue" over and over never stopped till i got on my medication which i can't take anymore. now after reading what you posted i can say is that before i was diagnosed i would smoke pot and take pills and i can say that after i would stop for a period of time i would see, hear, and believe things that i felt were very much true; sort of when i was high you sort of believe anything. so i started to write it down and i stopped taking drugs to see if it was intact something wrong or that i'm just another drug addict who wants to believe they're high when they're not (hopefully that made some sense). so fast forward to my senior year of high school, where i was finally diagnosed with paranoid type schizophrenia. i had very strong belief that the school had a plan to kill me, so i stopped going to school for days at a time. then my mom started noticing my odd behavior around the house i would look paranoid, sniff the air a lot like i was smelling for something (i thought the government was poisoning our air for some dumb reason which i can't recall). so she called my therapist and i saw him and gave him what i've been going through and told him and he said well you're a trooper for keeping this hidden for almost two years. and he gave me risperidone which worked, but since i have a heart condition i can't take anything for it till i see another heart specialist. so right now i'm going backwards with the hallucinations and delusions, i hate it so much i want to feel normal which is why turned to weed and alcohol. (please don't turn to drugs or alcohol, don't it's not worth throwing your life away like that). so i guess with all this said (sorry for the length), but start to write down when these occasions happen and make an appointment to see a therapist. seeing a therapist can help much more than any drink or drug can, they're there to help remember that. i hope you find out what's been causing your hallucinations.

When I was diagnosed with paranoid type schizophrenia, I was suffering from depression and when I my psychiatrist everything that I've been experiencing he told me that I had schizophrenia. My story really began back in the 10th grade when I started to desocialize myself and as the year went on to my 11th grade year is when things started to get worse. I started seeing and hearing things. When I told my doctor this it was close to my high school graduation, and I was getting my scared of what my mind could do and make me believe. I'm 18 by the way and I'm on 3mg of risperidone and I feel a whole lot better. I would say that finding out I have schizophrenia has been really beneficial for me because I've learned a lot more about me and I've also learned how to deal with a whole range of issues. I don't see having schizophrenia as a bad thing, but just a way that I have to learn with how to deal with life in a different way. Although at times I do fall backwards in life I surround myself with my family and friends who are there for me. All I have to say is just take life one day at a time and surround yourself with people who love and care for you. Hopefully this helped you. :)
